policy.aliases: Trailing slashes, percent-encoded separators/characters/backslashes and nested encoding receive the conservative API-specific limit where recognized; unknown aliases still have64KiB global limit.
policy.contentLength: Invalid syntax400; declared over-limit413 before read; actual bytes always counted; successful rebuilt Request gets actual byte length.
policy.overflow: Return 413 private/no-store/noindex/nosniff without explicit incoming body/reader cancellation; release acquired reader lock. Declared and chunked oversized cases passed both native Workerd and final rebuilt full-app local tests. No remote-production guarantee is inferred.
policy.streamFailure: Return intended 400 INVALID_REQUEST without logging content or explicitly canceling incoming transport; release the reader lock. Runtime owns subsequent cleanup.
policy.accepted: Reconstruct bounded Request preserving URL/method/headers/signal and explicit cf metadata. No character decoding or dispatch path rewrite.
policy.scope: All non-GET/HEAD bodies, including any Server Action request, receive these limits. New uploads or larger-body features require explicit policy review; this record does not assert that no Server Actions exist.
policy.allocation: One Uint8Array(limit) receive buffer; empty chunks do not accumulate array entries. Accepted bytes are copied into the buffer; an over-limit chunk is rejected before copying and no further chunk is requested. Runtime-provided chunk allocation and subsequent transport draining are outside this retained-buffer bound.
